shots.narration: Hasil penyelidikan itu menyebut dua puluh empat orang meninggal, sembilan di antaranya teridentifikasi namanya, dan empat belas lainnya tak dikenal — mereka itulah yang selama ini disebut orang hilang.
shots.visual_prompt: Nine named photographs pinned on a corkboard beside fourteen blank frames, a hand placing a name card under one portrait, a window's cold light across the board, dusty window light, cold grey daylight, archival stillness, named and nameless, a rusted shovel leaning against a tent pole, mud-caked boots waiting by the excavation pit

shots.narration: Sembilan nama itu antara lain Amir Biki, Zainal Amran, Kasmoro bin Jian, dan M. Romli, beserta lima nama lainnya. Empat belas sisanya hanya tercatat sebagai angka, tanpa nama, tanpa wajah, tanpa kubur.
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of nine identity photographs arranged in a row on a wooden table, an elderly woman touching one gently, a list of names handwritten beside them, dusty window light, cold grey daylight, archival stillness, faces the state finally named, a box of unlabelled photographs, faces staring up from the past, names missing

shots.narration: Syududu. Lalu datanglah islah: delapan puluh enam keluarga menerima islah pertama yang diwakili oleh Rambe, dan keluarga tokoh itu menerima islah kedua. Tetapi islah bukan jawaban atas angka yang hilang!
shots.visual_prompt: Reconciliation ceremony in a Jakarta community hall, eighty-six families seated in rows signing documents, a table with tea glasses and a stamp, late afternoon light through blinds, dusty window light, cold grey daylight, archival stillness, peace without answers, a cracked window letting in a shaft of grey daylight, rain beginning to patter outside

shots.narration: Delapan belas tahun kemudian, barulah pengadilan digelar. Sidang pengadilan HAM ad hoc dimulai sejak lima belas September dua ribu tiga, atas peristiwa yang terjadi di Tanjung Priok itu.
shots.visual_prompt: Stately human rights court building in Jakarta at dawn, a wide staircase leading to tall columns, a small group of lawyers arriving with briefcases, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, the law wakes up late, a marble staircase worn smooth by decades of footsteps, pigeons pecking at scattered crumbs
shots.video_prompt: Slow crane shot rising over a human rights court building at dawn, lawyers climbing the wide staircase, pale gold light on tall columns.

shots.narration: Empat belas terdakwa duduk di kursi pesakitan dalam empat berkas perkara. Nama-nama mereka disebut satu per satu: Sutrisno Mascung dan sepuluh anggotanya, Butar-butar, Pranowo, dan Sriyanto.
shots.visual_prompt: Courtroom interior at dawn, fourteen defendants seated in a row behind a wooden barrier, judges in black robes entering, a packed public gallery, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, fourteen men on trial, a court clerk carrying a stack of files, his shoes clicking on the polished stone floor

shots.narration: Di tingkat pertama, Butar-butar dijatuhi hukuman sepuluh tahun penjara, sementara Mascung hanya dua sampai tiga tahun. Vonis itu dibacakan dengan lantang, dan keluarga korban sempat menarik napas lega.
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of a judge reading a verdict in a Jakarta courtroom, a gavel resting on the bench, the defendant's bowed head in the foreground, a family member clutching a tissue, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, the first verdict, a bouquet of wilted flowers left at the courthouse gate, its ribbon faded by the sun
shots.video_prompt: Slow push-in on a judge reading a verdict, gavel resting on the bench, defendant's bowed head, a family member clutching a tissue.

shots.narration: Coba hitung: sidang dimulai lima belas September, tragedi terjadi dua belas September — bulan yang sama, September. Sembilan belas tahun menunggu, dan akhirnya mereka bertemu di bulan yang sama!
shots.visual_prompt: Symbolic image of two calendars on a courtroom wall, one showing September 1984 and one showing September 2003, a beam of dawn light falling between them, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, nineteen years apart, the same month, a journalist's camera flash popping in the morning light, notebooks open, pens ready

shots.narration: Tetapi banding dan kasasi membalikkan semuanya. Satu per satu para terdakwa dibebaskan, sampai akhirnya tak satu pelaku pun dinyatakan bersalah. Nol! Benar-benar nol besar!
shots.visual_prompt: Empty courtroom benches at dawn, a defendant's chair standing vacant, a dropped file on the floor, sunlight streaming through tall windows, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, acquittal after acquittal, a row of empty chairs in the public gallery, one jacket draped over a seat, waiting

shots.narration: Syalala. Kata hujan yang turun di halaman pengadilan sore itu, ia sudah hafal cerita ini. Hujan turun, membasahi tangga gedung, lalu pergi begitu saja — seperti keadilan yang mampir sebentar lalu pulang.
shots.visual_prompt: Rain falling on the steps of a Jakarta courthouse at dusk, raindrops bouncing off marble, an abandoned umbrella, a lone figure walking away, pale gold dawn light fading into grey, soft morning mist, muted hope, the rain has seen this before, a brass plaque beside the courtroom door, its engraved letters catching the dawn light

shots.narration: Kompensasi diberikan kepada tiga belas korban senilai satu miliar lima belas juta lima ratus ribu rupiah, berdasarkan putusan tertanggal dua puluh Agustus dua ribu empat. Uang itu dibayar, perkara dianggap selesai.
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of a compensation cheque and a court document on a wooden table, a hand counting banknotes, a family photo in soft focus behind, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, the price of a life on paper, a janitor mopping the marble floor, his bucket reflecting the pale gold of the morning

shots.narration: Jangan pergi dulu: satu miliar untuk tiga belas nyawa, silakan hitung sendiri berapa harga satu nyawa menurut putusan itu. Saya tidak mau menyebut angkanya — nanti saya yang dimarahi kalkulator!
shots.visual_prompt: Ironic scene of a pocket calculator on a courtroom bench showing a small number, a lawyer's briefcase beside it, dawn light through the window, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, arithmetic no one wants to do, a taxi waiting at the kerb, its driver reading a newspaper, the headline half visible

shots.narration: Pada tahun dua ribu dua puluh tiga, Presiden Jokowi mengakui dua belas pelanggaran HAM berat masa lalu. Dua belas kasus besar akhirnya diakui negara setelah puluhan tahun menunggu.
shots.visual_prompt: Presidential palace press conference in 2023, a president at a podium with microphones, a list of twelve cases projected on a screen behind him, television cameras, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, twelve names read aloud, a flock of birds crossing the pale sky above the courthouse dome, wings catching the light
shots.video_prompt: Slow push-in on a presidential press conference in 2023, a president at a podium, a list of twelve cases projected on the screen behind him.

shots.narration: Tetapi tragedi ini tidak masuk dalam daftar dua belas kasus itu, karena kasusnya sudah pernah dibawa ke pengadilan — pengadilan yang membebaskan semua terdakwanya. Alasannya rapi sekali, bukan?
shots.visual_prompt: A printed list of twelve recognised human rights cases lying on a desk, a red pen circling the absence of one name, a hand hovering uncertainly, pale gold dawn light, soft morning mist, muted hope, the missing thirteenth, a lawyer adjusting his tie in the reflection of a glass door, briefcase heavy in his hand

shots.narration: Hebat, kan? Sudah diadili, sudah dibebaskan, sudah selesai — katanya. Kalau begitu, ke mana perginya seratus tujuh puluh satu orang hilang itu? Apakah mereka juga ikut dibebaskan? Lucu sekali!

shots.narration: Jadi, berapa sebenarnya yang tewas pada malam itu di pelabuhan Jakarta Utara? Dua puluh empat, seratus, empat ratus, atau tujuh ratus? Jawabannya masih menunggu — dan mungkin hanya malam itu yang tahu.
